redactionStatement: All user identifiers, emails, session material, export contents, and personal data were removed before committing this proof artifact.

owner_export_request.expected: Owner can create export request and export job scoped to owner UID.

admin_process_export_job.expected: Admin can process export job and create private export package plus manifest.

owner_export_download_link.expected: Owner receives short-lived export download link only after export completion.

cross_user_export_denied.expected: Second user cannot read first user's export job or download link.

owner_deletion_request.expected: Owner can create deletion request and audit event.

admin_deletion_dry_run.expected: Admin dry-run returns plan hash without destructive deletion.

stale_deletion_hash_fails.expected: Execute with stale or missing plan hash fails closed.

legal_hold_blocks_deletion.expected: Active legal hold blocks destructive deletion and writes audit evidence.

admin_execute_deletion_current_hash.expected: Admin execute with current plan hash deletes supported user-scoped records and keeps retained evidence.

consent_grant_deny_revoke.expected: Consent grant deny and revoke create records events and audits.

user_audit_log_scope.expected: Owner sees only own actor or target audit events.

anonymous_access_denied.expected: Anonymous user cannot perform privacy-center operations.

admin_denied_without_claim.expected: Signed-in non-admin cannot view or mutate admin data.

admin_allowed_with_claim.expected: Admin with approved authority can perform allowed workflows and every action is audited.

storage_owner_admin_scope.expected: Export storage paths are not public and are owner or admin scoped.

firestore_deny_by_default.expected: Unknown collections and cross-user reads or writes fail closed.

monitoring_rollback_evidence.expected: Monitoring dashboard alert route rollback SHA and rollback smoke proof are attached.
